translations.zh: 慶立凡二十五年，乃歸國。
translations.literal: Qing had been established twenty-five years in all; then he returned to his state.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qing had held his title for twenty-five years in all before returning to his fief.

translations.zh: 其年病篤，謂宋衍等曰：「清河埤薄，[一]欲乞骸骨於貴人頤傍下棺而已。
translations.literal: That year he was gravely ill; he said to Song Yan and the others: 'Qinghe is low and thin; [one] I wish only to beg my bones be laid in a coffin beside the Honored Lady's mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: That year, gravely ill, he told Song Yan and his fellows, "Qinghe is low-lying and poor. Note [1]: I ask only to beg leave to lay my bones in a coffin beside my mother's tomb.

translations.zh: 朝廷大恩，猶當應有祠室，庶母子並食，魂靈有所依庇，死復何恨？」
translations.literal: The court's great grace should still provide a shrine chamber, so that mother and son may feast together and the soul have a place to rely on; what regret in death?'
translations.idiomatic: By the court's great grace there should still be a shrine, so mother and son may share offerings and our souls have a refuge—what regret could I have in death?"

translations.zh: 乃上書太后曰：「臣國土下濕，願乞骸骨，下從貴人於樊濯，雖歿且不朽矣。
translations.literal: Thereupon he submitted a memorial to the empress dowager saying: 'Your servant's state land is low and damp; I wish to beg my bones and descend to follow the Honored Lady at Fanzhuo; though dead I would yet be imperishable.'
translations.idiomatic: He then memorialized the empress dowager: "My domain is low and damp. I beg leave to lay my bones and follow my mother to Fanzhuo; though dead I would not perish."

translations.zh: 及今口目尚能言視，冒昧干請。
translations.literal: While now mouth and eyes can still speak and see, I presumptuously make this request.
translations.idiomatic: While I can still speak and see, I presumptuously make this request.

translations.literal: Life hangs on each breath; I wish to receive compassionate pity.'
translations.idiomatic: My life hangs on each breath; I beg your compassion."

translations.zh: 遣司空持節與宗正奉弔祭；
translations.literal: The Minister of Works was dispatched bearing credentials together with the director of the imperial clan to present condolence sacrifices;
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Works was sent with credentials, together with the director of the imperial clan, to offer condolence sacrifices;

translations.zh: 又使長樂謁者僕射、中謁者二人副護喪事；
translations.literal: also two Changle ushers, the director of attendants, and palace ushers were sent as deputies to oversee the funeral;
translations.idiomatic: and the director of Changle ushers plus two palace ushers were appointed deputies to oversee the funeral;

translations.zh: 賜龍旗九旒，虎賁百人，儀比東海恭王。
translations.literal: There were bestowed a dragon banner with nine tassels, one hundred tiger guards; the rites matched Prince Gong of the East Sea.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted a dragon banner with nine tassels, a hundred Tiger Guards, and funeral honors matching Prince Gong of the East Sea.

translations.zh: [二]太后使掖庭丞送左姬喪，與王合葬廣丘。
translations.literal: [Two] The empress dowager sent the assistant director of the Rear Palace to escort Lady Zuo Ji's funeral and bury her together with the prince at Guangqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Note [2]: The empress dowager sent an assistant director of the imperial harem to escort Lady Zuo Ji's remains, and she was buried with the prince at Guangqiu.
